purpose: Classify every property used by the visual-gate builder so PenPot implementation controls cannot be mistaken for new Core semantics.
rule: contract = directly declared variant/state/size in canonical contract; implementation = optional anatomy, bounded content configuration, or specimen value derived from contract constraints. Implementation properties never flow back into Core.

implementation.Content: single-line/two-line specimen required by PENPOT-SYNC density verification and textOverflowPolicy

implementation.Active: selection fixture used to inspect active/inactive child-state treatment; not a Core Tabs variant

implementation.Selected: current-destination fixture; not a new Core variant

implementation.Actions: canonical one-or-two-actions default plus vertical stacking constraint
implementation.Intent: destructive-action semantic treatment for destructive confirmation; not a Dialog variant

implementation.Rows: bounded content fixture within canonical default action-count range 2-6

implementation.Value: determinate specimen data required by accessibility contract; not a Core variant family

implementation.Current: fixture used to compose completed/current/upcoming child states; not a Core Stepper variant
